sources.title: calvadosdep/yolo26n-directional-signs · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: YOLO26n — French directional road sign detector YOLO26n fine-tuned to detect French directional road signs (destination sign assemblies) and roundabout signs in street-level imagery. Trained with strong scale augmentation for robustness across inference resolutions (640-1280).
